simple.meaning: לוּלֵא (lûwlêʼ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “if not.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 14 times in Genesis, Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 3 more, beginning at Genesis 31:42. The surrounding contexts include family, city, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לוּלֵא (H3884) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: לוּלֵא (lûwlêʼ) / H3884 is traced through Genesis 31:42, Genesis 43:10, Deuteronomy 32:27, Judges 14:18 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.usage: except, had not, if (...not), unless, were it not that.
definitions.full: H3884. luwle ' לוּלֵא Gen 43:10 ; Judg 14:18 ; 2Sam 2:27 ; Psa 27:13 , elsewhere לוּלֵי 10 if not, unless (from לוּ if , and לֵא , by dissimilation (Kö ii. 236, 489 ) for לֹא not ; compare Arabic ), the negative of לוּ , and used similarly: — a. followed by perfect, Judg 14:18 מצאתם לא ֗֗֗ חרשׁתם לולא unless ye had ploughed with my heifer, ye would not have found out my riddle, 1Sam 25:34 (second כי resumptive: כִּי 1d ), Psa 106:23 ; with apod, introd. by עַתָּה כִּי Gen 31:42 ; 43:10 ; by אָז 2Sam 2:27 ( כי resumptive); by כִּמְעַט Isa 1:9 ; with an aposiop. Psa 27:13 if I had not believed ...! b. followed by imperfect Deut 32:27 אגור לולי ֗֗֗ אמרתי I should have said, &c . . . . except I dreaded, &c. c. followed by participle, 2Kin 3:14 . d. without a verb , Psa 94:17 (apodosis כמעט ), 119:92 (apodosis אָז ). In the later language, 124:1 ; 124:2 - י ׳לוּלֵי שֶׁ (apodosis אֲזַי except that ... (compare Aramaic, 106:23 , דִּי ֗֗֗ אִילּוּלֵי 27:13 ᵑ7 ). — Read also לוּלֵי for אוּלַי in Num 22:33 (apodosis עַתָּה כִּי ). See further on לוּ and לוּלֵא Dr §§ 139-145 Kö iii. 487f; 565 .
